references.text: The Lord gives his friends sleep while they rest - the theme of God's protection and rest for His beloved
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High and abides in the shadow of the Almighty - parallel to dwelling safely under the Lord's protection
The Lord loves His people with everlasting love - the theme of being the Lord's beloved (yedid)
Benjamin's inheritance and territory, which lay near Jerusalem where the temple was built - between his shoulders
Benjamin as a tribe loved by the Lord, with Saul as the first king from Benjamin
Benjamin's birth and naming - he became his father's beloved son
Benjamin described as the beloved of his father Jacob
Paulus from the tribe of Benjamin - the tribe remained loved and preserved by God
